hints.title: Versioned Value History
hints.text: Rather than cloning the entire array per snapshot, record each value update alongside its active snapshot identifier.

hints.title: Per-Index Sorted Revision Logs
hints.text: Keep a list of (snap_id, val) entries for each index. The value at snapshot S is the most recent revision with snap_id <= S.

hints.title: Binary Search Lookup Blueprint
hints.text: Append (current_snap_id, val) to index history upon set. For get(index, snap_id), binary search the index history for the largest snap_id <= target.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.time: O(1) init, set, snap; O(log S) get
variables: U: total number of set operations
S: snapshots recorded for an index
complexity.notes: Binary search over revision history returns the latest version in logarithmic time.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Deep-copying the entire array on every snap takes O(N * S) time and memory, triggering time and memory limits.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Appending changes per index incurs sparse memory proportional only to mutations.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Avoid array cloning; use binary search over per-index versioned histories.
